0022600197.text: The Lakers arrive 7-2 through nine games, on a three-game win streak and 1st in the Pacific, with a 3-1 road record. The Pistons are 6-2 and 1st in the Central, but they come off a loss, and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) are both out. The teams have not met yet this season, and Los Angeles lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently a 113-110 defeat in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
